scopes.title: Historical SDSS-II detector and reduction chain
scopes.checked_claim: The historical SDSS-II Stripe82 release distinguishes corrected fpC images, uncalibrated fpObjc catalogs and calibrated tsObj catalogs. Its fpC format document distinguishes photo v5_3/DR1 from v5_2/EDR sky handling and says full aa/kk photometric calibration follows frame creation. The DR1 example carries ADU/DN pixel units, TAI first-row timing, drift-row clock and exposure time; those belong to the example. The pinned c447 SDSS reduced release instead contains calibrated photometry with blank TUNIT values and no EXPTIME, with README ancestry through SMPv8+BOSS and Holtz/v6_reCalib. The kcor input separately names SDSS_Doi2010_CCDAVG passbands and external SEDs.
scopes.unresolved: The physical event/CID/epoch to actual run, camcol, field, native exposure and reduction-version join is unresolved. No native SDSS detector array, bias/readout law, measured gain/read-noise uncertainty, per-epoch PSF/mask/sky covariance or extraction operator is acquired here. The example exposure/TAI convention cannot be assigned to PHOT. Native counts to microJy/asinh/AB/FLUXCAL, filter-body units and zeropoint calibration/covariance, censoring and full detection/followup/analysis selection remain incomplete. HST imaging/filter assets cannot fill this SDSS bridge.

scopes.title: B1608+656 named observations and conditioned reductions
scopes.checked_claim: The pinned Suyu et al. v2 source names ACS GO10158, PI Fassnacht, F606W/F814W and model-dependent PSF/dust/lens-light reductions; the official proposal body now matches the title/PI and selected ACS/WFC archive records J93501010/20/30/40 for B1608+656. Older proposal6555 is a distinct WFPC2 dataset. The paper separately names radio delays relative to imageB, Keck1/LRIS red exposures on 2007-06-12, aperture/template-dependent stellar dispersion and an OBS external-convergence prior conditioned on galaxy counts and simulations. Pinned H0LiCOW README describes B1608 analytical distance fits as inference products.
scopes.unresolved: Matched proposal metadata does not supply raw or calibrated pixel files, exact pipeline/product versions, units/clock convention, PSF ensembles, masks/dust/lens-light/potential reductions or image covariance. Original monitoring light curves and joint delay covariance, Keck spectra/templates/aperture/seeing likelihood, environment catalog completeness and conditioned simulated sightline assets remain unacquired. The reported stellar dispersion includes statistical and template-mismatch uncertainty and is not an SIS parameter. An external-convergence prior is not a direct convergence measurement. Cross-covariances and original-data joint likelihood remain unknown; distance-fit summaries do not replace these assets.

limitations: The declared baselines are historical SDSS-II Stripe82/SMPv8+BOSS reduced photometry and the named Suyu2010 B1608 observations/reductions; they are source identities, not a combined physical model or independent datasets.

Unknown pixel, extraction, calibration, delay, kinematic and environment cross-covariances remain unknown. No Gaussian, Poisson, independent-event or detector censoring law is inferred from gain/read-noise columns, uncertainty bars, offset covariance or posterior summaries.

The B1608 template-derived dispersion is an aperture/spectral-fit measurement with reported statistical and template-mismatch uncertainty. Its environment prior conditions simulated sightlines on selected galaxy counts, including an approximate F814W magnitude from simulated SDSS i/z magnitudes; this is not a measured optical passband bridge.

No raw detector history, complete lens likelihood, parameter tolerance, executable numerical request or scientific qualification is supplied. Missing assets in this bounded check are unacquired or unresolved, not demonstrated absent.
